# A $1,500 day at a $250 booth is not $1,250.

> Free calculator for makers: find what one craft fair, farmers market, or art festival booth has to sell to break even after booth fee, jury fee, mileage, materials, and card fees — plus your real hourly rate for the weekend and the most a booth could cost and still be worth it.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
